BrochureContent.Content:
Jeremy Murphy & Associates are delighted to bring to the market this 3 Bedroom Apartment located on the South Douglas Road. This spacious three-bedroom apartment at Sunview Court offers comfortable modern living in a convenient and well-connected location. The property provides excellent accommodation for families, , or those looking to enjoy the benefits of apartment living close to the city.

The apartment features three well-proportioned bedrooms, a bright living space, and a practical layout designed for everyday comfort. Sunview Court is a mature residential development, offering a peaceful setting while remaining within easy reach of Cork City Centre, Douglas Village, and a wide range of local amenities.

The location is one of the property’s key attractions, with shops, cafés, restaurants, schools, pharmacies, and leisure facilities all nearby. Douglas Village and Douglas Court shopping facilities are easily accessible, while Cork City Centre is just a short commute away. The area also benefits from convenient transport links, including nearby bus routes and easy access to the South Ring Road network.

FRONT OF PROPERTY
Balcony to the front along with car parking space.

ENTRANCE HALLWAY     1.92m x 5.34m
A timber door leads into the entrance hallway. The entrance hallway comprises of timber flooring, one radiator, and one centre light.

KITCHEN/DINING/LIVING   7.16mx 3.44m
The Kitchen has tiled flooring, one centre light, and one radiator.  It is fitted with a range of kitchen units offering excellent storage space, along with a stainless-steel sink and drainer, integrated dishwasher, space for a fridge, and an integrated oven with a four-ring hob and extractor fan overhead.

The dining/living area benefits from timber flooring, one radiator, and one centre light. A glass door provides access to the front balcony, while the room offers generous space for a dining table with seating for four to six people, creating a bright and comfortable living environment.

DOWNSTAIRS BATHROOM 1.77m x 2.36m
Three-piece bathroom suite incorporating one shower, a washbasin and a w.c. The floors and walls are tiled and features one centre light and one radiator.

BEDROOM 3			  2.58m x 5.18m
This double bedroom features carpet fitted flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one window overlooking the rear.

STAIRS & LANDING         1.97m x 0.97m
The stairs and landing are fully carpeted. Via the landing there is one centre light along with access to the hot-press and attic.

MASTER BEDROOM         3.40m x 4.88m
This double bedroom features carpet fitted flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one window overlooking the front. There is also built in wardrobe units.

ENSUITE 			       0.87m x 2.72m
There are tiled walls and flooring, one shower, one wash hand basin and a wc. The ensuite also incorporates one centre light, one extractor fan and one radiator.

BEDROOM 2 		       3.08m x 4.46m
This double bedroom features carpet fitted flooring, one centre light, one radiator and one window overlooking the rear.

ENSUITE 			       2.35m x 0.89m
There are tiled walls and flooring, one shower, one wash hand basin and a wc. The ensuite also incorporates one centre light, one extractor fan and one radiator.
